name: freightchain-monorepo
description: Freight Chain – client/ (the game + lobby, vanilla ES modules + three.js), landing/ (the / page, Vite) and server/ (NestJS, serves both). Each has its own package.json; these scripts just delegate.

scripts.server:test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run landing:build && npm run server:build
scripts.check: npm run client:check && npm run landing:lint && npm run landing:build && npm run landing:test && npm run server:build && npm run server:test
